approaches.title: Hash map with separate clone construction
approaches.summary: Maps each original list node to its corresponding clone information, then connects next and random pointers in later passes. Revision 2 simplifies the representation to a direct original-node-to-clone-node map.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Builds an index-based intermediate representation using node hash codes, then constructs the cloned list and assigns random pointers.

revisions.commitComment: much simpler direct node to node map
revisions.rawCommitSubject: java 138: much simpler direct node to node map
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces the hash-code and index structures with a direct Map<Node, Node>, using two passes to create clones and connect both pointers.

approaches.title: Interleaved clone nodes
approaches.summary: Inserts each clone immediately after its original node, allowing random pointers to be resolved without a map. It then separates the interleaved list into the original and copied lists using constant auxiliary space.

revisions.commitComment: store cloned nodes by interleaving them in the linked list
revisions.rawCommitSubject: java 138: store cloned nodes by interleaving them in the linked list
revisions.commitBody:
- node1 -> node1_clone -> node2 -> node2_clone -> node3 ...

1. create clones & interleave them

2. iterate through linked list to update the random pointer (clone is
always contained in it's original's .next)

3. seperate the interleaved linkedlist at the end

no hashmap needed. O(1) auxiliary space
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Creates and interleaves clones, assigns random pointers through each original's next node, and then separates the two lists without a hashmap.
